name: LE3CH
detailed_description:
LE3CH is a psychological horror game set in 1994, where paranoia spreads like a virus. Out of options, you take a shady office job with no background check, no contract, and no real information. At first, it’s just typing, emails, and tasks. But soon, strange files appear. Your screen glitches. You start hearing things—seeing things.

A silent stalker has infected your PC with a remote access trojan (RAT), digging through your files, uncovering your secrets, and warping your reality. The deeper you go, the more control they take—over your desktop, your environment, and maybe even your mind.

Gameplay blends retro computer simulation with immersive horror mechanics. You’ll navigate your desktop, read unsettling emails, solve cryptic tasks, and piece together the identity of the hacker—before they erase everything. Expect jump scares, fourth-wall breaks, and disturbing moments that bleed from your virtual PC into your real one.

With each shift, you’ll unlock fragments of your past, uncovering a conspiracy tied to missing persons, an underground network, and something much more sinister. But the further you dig, the more personal the attacks become.

You’re not alone on your PC anymore.
The question is: who’s really in control?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-4130 or AMD FX-4100
  • Memory: 4096 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4600 / NVIDIA GT 710
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 2000 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated
  • Additional Notes: Basic hardware required. Performance may vary on older systems.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-7400 or AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8192 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 750 Ti / AMD Radeon R7 260X or better
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 2000 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated or better
  • Additional Notes: Ideal for smooth gameplay at 1080p.
